items.heading: Pierogi
details: Key ingredients: flour dough, potato, cheese, onion
Make a simple dough of flour, water and egg.
Fill rolled dough circles with mashed potato and cheese.
Fold and crimp into half-moon dumplings.
Boil until they float, then pan-fry briefly with onion for extra flavor.

items.heading: Bigos
details: Key ingredients: sauerkraut, cabbage, mixed meats, sausage
Simmer sauerkraut and fresh cabbage together.
Add a variety of meats and sausage.
Cook slowly for a long time, letting the flavors deepen.
Reheat the next day for even better flavor before serving.
